help:
**FlightWatch commands**

**Search only, no watch is saved:**
`/flight search <origin> <destination> <from> <to> [currency]`
`/flight returnsearch <origin> <destination> <outbound-from> <outbound-to> <return-from> <return-to> [currency]`
`/flight explore <origin> <from> <to> [currency]`

**Price alerts:**
`/flight watch <origin> <destination> <year> <month> [currency] [limit]`
`/flight returnwatch <origin> <destination> <outbound-year> <outbound-month> <return-year> <return-month> [currency] [total-limit]`
`/flight returnwatchdates <origin> <destination> <outbound-from> <outbound-to> <return-from> <return-to> [currency] [total-limit]`

For each `<from>`/`<to>` pair, use either two months (`YYYY-MM`) or two exact dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`); do not mix formats.
Manage: `/flight watches`, `/flight unwatch <id>`, `/flight check`. IATA codes: `/flight airports`. Language: `/flight language <auto|cs|en>`.
invalid_return_dates: Enter valid ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD), with the return window starting on or after the outbound window starts.
invalid_return_months: The return month must be the same as or later than the outbound month.
no_return_fares: Ryanair returned no matching return trips for those date windows.
explore_empty: Ryanair returned no fares in that date window.
explore_header: Lowest fares from **{origin}** ({from_date} to {to_date}, {currency}) — search only; nothing is saved:
api_error: Ryanair could not complete the search right now. Please try again later.
invalid_limit: The price limit must be greater than zero.
duplicate: This route and month are already being tracked in this channel.
watch_created: Tracking **{origin} → {destination}**, {period}: current low **{price:.2f} {currency}** ({date}){cap}. Watch ID: `{watch_id}`. Checks every {minutes} minutes.
return_watch_created: Tracking return fares **{origin} ↔ {destination}**, outbound {outbound_from} to {outbound_to}, return {return_from} to {return_to}: current low **{price:.2f} {currency} total** ({out_date} / {return_date}){cap}. Watch ID: `{watch_id}`. Checks every {minutes} minutes.
return_watch_month_created: Tracking **{origin} ↔ {destination}**, outbound {outbound_period}, return {return_period}: lowest return fare is **{price:.2f} {currency} total**. Watch ID: `{watch_id}`. Checks every {minutes} minutes.{cap}
return_watch_duplicate: These return date windows are already being tracked in this channel.
watches_empty: There are no fare alerts configured for this server.
watch_unknown: I couldn't find a watch with that ID.
invalid_airport: Use three-letter IATA airport codes, for example PRG and STN.
same_airport: Origin and destination must be different airports.
invalid_date: The year or month is outside the supported range.
invalid_date_range: Enter a valid future date range in YYYY-MM-DD format, within the supported years.
invalid_period_format: Use either two months (YYYY-MM) or two exact dates (YYYY-MM-DD) for each date range; do not mix formats.
past_month: You cannot search a month that has already started in the past.
invalid_currency: Currency must be a three-letter code, for example EUR or GBP.
no_fares: Ryanair returned no fares for this route and month.
